description: Returns the complete GodPrompt.md — a single-file universal system prompt for AI software development (63KB, ~1145 lines). With no arguments, returns the original full text for backward compatibility. Bridges may truncate the middle of such a large response: pass start (initially 0) and maxChars (at most 8192) to retrieve bounded, lossless chunks; structuredContent.nextStart gives the next offset, or null at EOF. For progressive disclosure, use get_core_skill and references instead.
name: get_god_prompt
title: Get full GodPrompt
